title: Create language code helper utilities
description: Add _get_language_code_variants() helper in bazarr.py to map between 2-letter and 3-letter ISO codes (en/eng/english, fi/fin/finnish, es/spa/spanish, etc.). Add _normalize_language_code() in output.py to prefer 2-letter codes for filenames. Include mappings for ~15 common languages.

title: Add source_language and target_language fields to Config dataclass
description: Update Config dataclass in models.py to add source_language and target_language fields (ISO 639-1/2 codes). Default to 'en' and 'fi' for backwards compatibility. Update config.py loader to parse these from YAML with defaults and basic validation (warn if invalid length).

title: Multi-language support: translate between any language pair
description: Transform the subtitle translator from English→Finnish only to support any language pair (e.g., English→Spanish, German→French, Japanese→English), while maintaining English→Finnish as the default. This requires systematic refactoring of hardcoded language references, introducing language configuration, and making translation prompts language-agnostic.

title: Refactor TranslationContext formality field to be language-agnostic
description: Rename TranslationContext.formality to formality_guidance (free-form string). Update cache.py load function to handle both old and new field names for backwards compatibility. Update all references in translator.py and tests.

title: Preview analysis JSON before translation
description: Show the Pass 1 translation context JSON to the user before Pass 2 runs. After `analyze_subtitles` (or loading cached context) in `cli.process_movie`, pretty-print `TranslationContext.raw_json` with Rich so the user can verify character/term handling, then pause unless a skip flag is provided. Skip preview when analysis is disabled or we are in dry-run/extract-only modes.
acceptance_criteria:
- Add CLI flag `--skip-preview` and YAML `translation.skip_preview` (default false) that flow through `Config` into `process_movie`; keep defaults in sync with `config.example.yml` and CLI help text.
- When `skip_analysis` is false and `context.raw_json` exists (from analysis or cache) and `skip_preview` is false, pretty-print the JSON with syntax highlighting/indentation before translation; log when preview is skipped because data is missing or the flag is set.
- After printing, prompt waits for Enter to continue to translation; non-interactive sessions auto-continue rather than hanging.
- Preview step is automatically bypassed when `dry_run` or `extract_only` is set; caching behavior unchanged (preview can use cached context on subsequent runs).
- Tests in `tests/test_cli.py` (with OpenAI/translation mocked and `input` monkeypatched) cover both preview and skip-flag paths; README/config docs mention the new flag.
notes: Use `console.print_json` with `TranslationContext.raw_json` (already a dict) for color output. Add the flag to `argparse` and the `Config` dataclass/loader, and pass it into `process_movie`. In tests, stub `analyze_subtitles` to return a `TranslationContext` with `raw_json` and stub `translate_subtitles_batch` to avoid network calls, then assert `print_json`/prompt calls depending on the flag.

title: Make Bazarr integration language-agnostic
description: Update get_wanted_movies() in bazarr.py to accept target_language parameter. Use _get_language_code_variants() to filter for any language code. Remove hardcoded 'fi'/'fin' checks. Update all callers to pass config.target_language.

title: Make translation prompts language-agnostic
description: Update analyze_subtitles() and build_translation_prompt() in translator.py to accept source_language and target_language parameters. Remove all Finnish-specific examples (te/sinä, Oh→Voi, Juha). Use generic instructions that work for any language pair. Update translate_subtitles_batch() accordingly.

title: Wire language parameters through CLI orchestration
description: Update cli.py to pass source_language and target_language from config through process_movie(), select_movies_interactive(), and all function calls. Add _get_language_display_name() helper for user-facing messages. Update argparser description to 'translate between languages' instead of 'English to Finnish'.

title: Update config.example.yml with language settings
description: Add source_language and target_language fields to translation section in config.example.yml. Add comprehensive comments explaining ISO codes, examples of different language pairs (en→es, de→fr, ja→en). List common language codes. Set defaults to en and fi.

title: Enforce English-only subtitle sourcing
description: Enforce an English-only (or allowlisted) source subtitle policy across external SRT discovery and MKV tracks. Apply a configurable allowed-language list so non-English files/tracks are skipped with clear logging instead of being used as translation input.
acceptance_criteria:
- Add config option `translation.allowed_source_languages` (list of language codes, case-insensitive) defaulting to English; wire it through the `Config` dataclass/loader/CLI so helpers can access it, and document it in `config.example.yml`.
- `find_external_srt` only returns files matching the allowed codes (e.g., .en/.eng/.english). Remove the current fallback to arbitrary `.srt` when no allowed match exists and log when rejecting other locales (e.g., movie.de.srt skipped because allowed=[en]).
- MKV track handling filters `get_mkv_subtitle_tracks` results to the allowed languages before prompting; if none remain, log and return `(None, False)` so the movie is skipped gracefully.
- Add regression tests in `tests/processing/test_subtitles.py`: default rejects `.de.srt`; allowlist override accepts it; track filtering keeps only allowed languages; update existing fallback test expectations accordingly.
- Keep messaging consistent with Bazarr filtering (still English-by-default) and avoid caching non-allowed tracks/files.
notes: Language comparison should be lower-cased and accept both 2- and 3-letter codes (`en`/`eng`). Pass the allowlist into subtitle helpers from `process_movie`. When logging skips, include the filename or track metadata to help users adjust config. If allowed list is empty, treat as default English to avoid silently allowing everything.

title: End-to-end testing with multiple language pairs
description: Manually test complete workflow: 1) English→Spanish translation, 2) German→French translation, 3) Backwards compatibility with config lacking language fields (should default to en→fi), 4) 3-letter language codes (e.g., 'spa' instead of 'es'), 5) Cache compatibility with old field names.

title: Update output naming to use target language code
description: Rename save_finnish_subtitle() to save_translated_subtitle() in output.py. Add target_language parameter. Use _normalize_language_code() to generate output filename (movie.{lang}.srt). Update all callers to pass target language.

title: Update all tests for multi-language support
description: Update test_config.py to test language fields. Update test_models.py for formality_guidance. Update test_bazarr.py for language parameter. Rename tests in test_subtitles.py and test_output.py for renamed functions. Add tests for language code helpers. Add backwards compatibility tests.

title: Skip movies missing English subtitles from Bazarr list
description: Only list Bazarr wanted movies that already have English subtitles to translate from. In `integrations/bazarr.get_wanted_movies`, inspect the `/api/movies/wanted` payload and skip/log any movie that lacks an English subtitle entry before we display the selection table.
acceptance_criteria:
- `get_wanted_movies` filters results to movies that both miss Finnish subtitles and have an English subtitle present in `subtitles` (check `code2`/`code3`/`language`, case-insensitive); if English is absent or explicitly listed in `missing_subtitles`, skip it.
- Console logs each skip with the movie title and detected languages (e.g., `Skipping <title> - no English subtitles available (found: fr, de)`).
- `Movie.existing_subtitles` continues to store the raw subtitle metadata for retained movies; downstream path population is unchanged.
- Add unit tests in `tests/integrations/test_bazarr.py` that stub `httpx.Client.get` to return sample JSON and verify English filtering + skip logging; no real HTTP calls.
- Update README/CLI messaging if needed to note we only list movies when an English source subtitle is present.

title: Allow user selection of MKV subtitle track
description: Let users choose which MKV text subtitle track to extract when multiple tracks exist. After discovering tracks in `processing.subtitles.get_mkv_subtitle_tracks`, display the options (id/lang/name/codec) and let the user confirm or pick a track; the chosen track drives caching and extraction.
acceptance_criteria:
- If no external SRT is found and there are multiple text tracks after filtering (non-PGS), list them in the terminal (table or numbered list with track id/language/name/codec) and prompt for selection. Enter selects the default (prefer the first English track if present, otherwise the first track); invalid input re-prompts or falls back with a clear message.
- When stdin is non-interactive, skip prompting and use the default selection automatically so automated runs do not hang.
- The selected `SubtitleTrack.track_id` is used for cache lookup/extraction; console logs which track was chosen. Single-track cases auto-select without prompting.
- Add tests in `tests/processing/test_subtitles.py` using monkeypatched `input` and stubbed `extract_subtitle_from_mkv`/`get_mkv_subtitle_tracks` to assert the chosen track id flows through and that prompting is skipped when only one track/default is used.
- Refresh docstrings/log output to reflect user-choice behavior and keep compatibility with any language filtering from the allowed-language config.
notes: Consider a helper like `choose_subtitle_track(tracks, default_langs=['en', 'eng'])` to encapsulate prompting/TTY detection. `SubtitleTrack.language` currently holds codes like 'eng', 'spa'; show `track_name` when present. Ensure the track id fed into `get_subtitle_cache_path`/`extract_subtitle_from_mkv` matches the user's choice to avoid reusing the wrong cache.

title: Update documentation for multi-language support
description: Update CLAUDE.md to reflect language-agnostic architecture. Update README.md with examples of different language pairs. Update all docstrings to remove Finnish-specific terminology. Add migration guide for users. Update comments in all affected files.

title: Refactor subtitle detection for any source language
description: Rename get_english_subtitle() to get_source_subtitle() in subtitles.py. Add source_language parameter. Update find_external_srt() to search for any language pattern using _get_language_code_variants(). Update MKV track search to match any language. Update all callers.
